notes: Commonly used in place of a pronoun ('I' by a mother speaking to her child, or 'you' by a child speaking to their mother), often preceded by คุณ (คุณแม่).
Placed before an animal name to mean a mother or adult female animal (e.g. แม่ไก่ 'mother hen, hen'), and in many compounds for female roles (e.g. แม่บ้าน 'housewife', แม่ค้า 'female vendor').

senses.definition: A female parent of a person or animal.
